```r
[library](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)(dslabs)
[library](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)([caret](https://github.com/topepo/caret/))
#> Loading required package: lattice
knn_fit <- [knn3](https://rdrr.io/pkg/caret/man/knn3.html)(y ~ ., data = mnist_27$train, k = 5)
```

```r
y_hat_knn <- [predict](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/predict.html)(knn_fit, mnist_27$train, type = "class")
[mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(y_hat_knn == mnist_27$train$y)
#> [1] 0.858
 y_hat_knn <- [predict](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/predict.html)(knn_fit, mnist_27$test, type = "class")
[mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(y_hat_knn == mnist_27$test$y)
#> [1] 0.815
```
